itemdesc-speedcoil: Upon being equipped, the player's speed shall be increased, which might probaly twice the speed of YOU. Now according to Roblox Wiki, Speed Coil is a gear that was published in the marketplace by Roblox Roblox Admin Badge on November 30, 2012. It can be purchased for 250 Robux. As of May 15, 2020, it has been purchased 142,315 times and favorited 22,544 times. It is the 2nd coil of the Coil series.
itemdesc-gravitycoil: Upon being equipped, the player's height jump shall be increased, thus enabling the user to jump at a much higher height. Now according to Roblox Wiki, Gravity Coil is a gear that was published in the Marketplace by Roblox Roblox Admin Badge on October 9, 2009. It can be purchased for 250 Robux. As of October 14, 2024, it has been favorited 110,758 times. It is the first gear in the Coil series.
itemdesc-regencoil: Upon being equipped, the player's health is regenerating faster than it should be. Now according to Roblox Wiki, Regeneration Coil is a gear that was published in the marketplace by Roblox Roblox Admin Badge on June 14, 2013. It can be purchased for 250 Robux. As of May 15, 2020, it has been purchased 21,620 times and favorited 9,959 times. It is the 3rd gear in the Coil series.
